citations.author: Seperation of Dead and State
citations.quote_or_claim: This show shows the dead in typical '86 form...sloppy but inspiring. Great little first set with a sorrowful FOTD and a lilting loping C.C. Rider. Second set…
citations.title: Review: This one's for Len Bias (gd86-06-21.sbd.brame.15406.sbeok.shnf)

citations.author: geofgibson
citations.quote_or_claim: I was there and standing 50 feet in front of Jerry. The sound was dialed in, crisp and clean, as were the doses ;) This show was so good I didn't want to leave.
citations.title: Review: Oh wow, man! (gd86-06-21.sbd.brame.15406.sbeok.shnf)

citations.author: El_Duderino
citations.quote_or_claim: Good, solid '86 show. The Saint (even if a bit sloppy) and the He's Gone>Smokestack are standouts. Great sound quality.
citations.title: Review: I love this show (gd86-06-21.sbd.brame.15406.sbeok.shnf)

citations.author: capn doubledose
citations.quote_or_claim: And I am sure the Greek was humming that night but this show is lacking the oomph it should have especially with the setting and the song list. Nice shout out…
citations.title: Review: Good for '86 (gd86-06-21.sbd.brame.15406.sbeok.shnf)

citations.author: Havergill Milk
citations.quote_or_claim: Wow! The quality of this audience is superb!I guess everyone goes for the boards, but I like to have the best of both aud and sbd. This is highly recommended…
citations.title: Review: Goodness! (gd86-06-21.oade-schoeps.sacks.21924.sbeok.flacf)

citations.author: liranfa
citations.quote_or_claim: I love these recordings. They truly capture the "experience" of being at a GD show. This show may not look "special" from the set list but the China Cat/Rider…
citations.title: Review: Oade does it again (gd86-06-21.oade-schoeps.sacks.21924.sbeok.flacf)

citations.author: drgnw/mtchs
citations.quote_or_claim: This show, or version of FOTM, is the reason I got into the Dead. I had never heard of "the Dead" my first 16yrs of life, and then a kid w/ an older brother…
citations.title: Review: jerry w/matches loose on the town!!!! (gd86-06-21.oade-schoeps.sacks.21924.sbeok.flacf)

citations.author: lobster12
citations.quote_or_claim: This show should have more heat. Not bad but not as powerful as it could be. Still remember my ole mann calling me from work telling me len Bias Overdosed.
citations.title: Review: concur with the captain (gd86-06-21.sbd.brame.15406.sbeok.shnf)

citations.author: Supaslush
citations.quote_or_claim: The setlist pretty much speaks for itself. Energy runs up and down this show. Ever listen to a tape and feel the need to cheer, even though you’re walking down…
citations.title: Review: Great '86! (gd86-06-21.senn.eD.13063.sbeok.shnf)

citations.author: pnc
citations.quote_or_claim: This is an excellent sounding aud...better than many of the sbds on this the LMA. Good show as well.
citations.title: Review: really good aud! (gd86-06-21.senn.eD.13063.sbeok.shnf)

citations.author: CFD6149
citations.quote_or_claim: Had a fantastic night painting my bathroom and listening to this show. Band is rocking, sound is nice, great songs, beautiful. Download.
citations.title: Review: nice audience (gd86-06-21.senn.eD.13063.sbeok.shnf)

citations.author: garquia
citations.quote_or_claim: Thanks to Oade for ecoeding this amazing show. The quality of the recording is as good as it get for the person looking for that "one!"tape. THe show is played…
citations.title: Review: THanks to OADE!! (gd86-06-21.oade-schoeps.sacks.21924.sbeok.flacf)

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **C.C. Rider** (2 reviews): C.C. Rider was lilting and loping in the first set; Jerry gave Weir props after some of his better slide work in C.C. Rider [25][36]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (2 reviews): China Cat into Rider is called outstanding; China Cat into Rider drew a loud audience cheer, which the reviewer found especially satisfying on the tape [30][33]
- **Friend of the Devil** (1 review): Friend of the Devil in the first set came across as sorrowful [25]
- **Saint of Circumstance** (1 review): Reviewer thinks this Saint of Circumstance was the first without Lost Sailor, probably a relief [33]
- **He's Gone** (1 review): Reviewer notes a sweet gospel breakdown in He's Gone [33]
- **The Other One** (1 review): Reviewer calls it one of the year's best; the band jammed on it instead of a Space break, skipping Phil's intro [30]

## Setlist highlights

- **Phil info/tuning**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [37]
- **We Want Phil chant**: rare: 3 archived performances [37]

## The recordings

- **gd86-06-21.senn.eD.13063.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 24 songs; 137 min; rated 4.33/5 by 3 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the audience recording's sound nice [35]
- **gd1986-06-21.mtx.sirmick.35035.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 144 min [2]
- **gd1986-06-21.148479.neumann.km84i.hecht.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 21 songs; 143 min [3]
- **gd1986-06-21.fob.schoeps.grace-szvetecz.gems.98673.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 22 songs; 150 min [5]
- **gd86-06-21.sbd.brame.15406.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 140 min; rated 4.29/5 by 7 [12]. Said about its sound: Reviewer, who stood about 50 feet from Jerry, says the sound was crisp, clean and dialed in [26]
- **gd86-06-21.oade-schoeps.sacks.21924.sbeok.flacf**: source not stated; 20 songs; 141 min; rated 4.17/5 by 6 [21]. Said about its sound: Audience recording is described as superb, with everything crystal clear; Reviewer says the Oade-Schoeps audience recordings capture the experience of being at a Dead show; Oade's recording is praised as top quality, blending audience and soundboard qualities and showing the band's arrangements [29][30][36]

## Around the show

- A shout-out to Len Bias was made during the show [28]
- Reviewer recalls his father calling from work that day to say Len Bias had overdosed [32]
- The set 2 soundboard has extended tuning at the start and about 1:29 missing from the Not Fade Away crowd chant [2]
- Reviewer says the band played in typical 1986 form, sloppy yet inspiring, and liked the He's Gone into Smokestack pairing that year [25]
- Reviewer finds the show lacking oomph given the setting and song list [28]
- Reviewer feels the show lacks heat and is less powerful than it could have been [32]
- Reviewer says Weir's playing here ranks among his best of the mid-80s [36]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd86-06-21.senn.eD.13063.sbeok.shnf**: source: AUD>MC>DAT>CDR [1]
- **gd1986-06-21.mtx.sirmick.35035.flac16**: transferred by SIRMick; source: GANS SBD + OADE AUD [2]. Also: Mixed source: set 1 soundboard transferred by David Gans, set 2 soundboard cassette master by Laurie Partridge, plus Jim Oade's Schoeps audience [2]
- **gd1986-06-21.148479.neumann.km84i.hecht.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Chris Hecht; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Chris Hecht's Master Audience Cassettes; Neumann KM84i mics > Sony D5M [3]
- **gd1986-06-21.fob.schoeps.grace-szvetecz.gems.98673.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Mike Grace and Annie Szvetecz; transferred by Todd Evans and Jamie Waddell; source: OTS, Schoeps CMC42 (Spread Omnis, Spaced 3 Feet Apart with 180 degree angle of incidence) -> Grace 18v Mic Preamp -> MOD PCM-F1 [5]. Also: Schoeps recording transferred to 16-bit WAV from PCM tapes; dropouts were fixed by replaying problem sections and patching in Wavelab [5]
- **gd86-06-21.sbd.brame.15406.sbeok.shnf**: source: MSC>DAT>CDR>SHN [12]
- **gd86-06-21.oade-schoeps.sacks.21924.sbeok.flacf**: source: Jim Oade Recording -- 120 degree Schoeps CMC44 ->MOD PCM-1Transfer: Master PCM>DAW (via Sekd card)> DSP by Doug Oade using Audacity (Linux) -- Downloaded,… [21]

- Poster by Ron Delany Grateful Dead: [1986-06-22 Greek Theatre, Berkeley, CA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1986-06-22-greek-theatre-berkeley-ca/) [39]

claims.text: Friend of the Devil in the first set came across as sorrowful
C.C. Rider was lilting and loping in the first set
Reviewer says the band played in typical 1986 form, sloppy yet inspiring, and liked the He's Gone into Smokestack pairing that year
Reviewer, who stood about 50 feet from Jerry, says the sound was crisp, clean and dialed in
A shout-out to Len Bias was made during the show
Reviewer finds the show lacking oomph given the setting and song list
Audience recording is described as superb, with everything crystal clear
China Cat into Rider is called outstanding
Reviewer calls it one of the year's best; the band jammed on it instead of a Space break, skipping Phil's intro
Reviewer says the Oade-Schoeps audience recordings capture the experience of being at a Dead show
Reviewer feels the show lacks heat and is less powerful than it could have been
Reviewer recalls his father calling from work that day to say Len Bias had overdosed
China Cat into Rider drew a loud audience cheer, which the reviewer found especially satisfying on the tape
Reviewer thinks this Saint of Circumstance was the first without Lost Sailor, probably a relief
Reviewer notes a sweet gospel breakdown in He's Gone
Reviewer finds the audience recording's sound nice
Jerry gave Weir props after some of his better slide work in C.C. Rider
Oade's recording is praised as top quality, blending audience and soundboard qualities and showing the band's arrangements
Reviewer says Weir's playing here ranks among his best of the mid-80s
Mixed source: set 1 soundboard transferred by David Gans, set 2 soundboard cassette master by Laurie Partridge, plus Jim Oade's Schoeps audience
The set 2 soundboard has extended tuning at the start and about 1:29 missing from the Not Fade Away crowd chant
Master cassette from Chris Hecht, transferred by Charlie Miller, with a 29-second Drums patch from Oade's Schoeps source
Schoeps recording transferred to 16-bit WAV from PCM tapes; dropouts were fixed by replaying problem sections and patching in Wavelab
